adaptation_ctx.background: Public CHAIFest visitor with no causality background
adaptation_ctx.learning_goal: Understand why a healthcare attendance pattern is not always proof of cause and effect

grounded_chunks.text: Use GP or clinic appointment text reminders. Central question: Patients who received a text reminder were more likely to attend their appointment. Does that mean the text reminder caused better attendance? Use variables Z = patient engagement / digital access / life stability, T = receiving a text reminder, Y = attending the appointment. Explain that Z may affect both T and Y. Explain random assignment of reminders among eligible patients as the intervention idea. Keep medically safe: no clinical advice or treatment effectiveness claims.
An intervention replaces the usual assignment mechanism for a variable. Under a hard intervention on T, incoming causes of T are removed, while other relevant causal links may remain.
